verdict.rationale: Docs confirm real-time authorization webhooks with merchant category (MCC) and card-presence data usable for spending controls, ML-generated risk scores per authorization, and wallet-provisioned cards (Apple/Google/Samsung Pay), which together give some decision-grade context. However, there's no explicit documentation of merchant name fields, 'enhanced' merchant data enrichment, entry-mode (chip/tap/manual) detail, or partial-approval/incremental-auth signals on the authorization object itself — only capture-side partial/over-capture tracking is mentioned, not authorization-time partial approvals. missing for 10: explicit merchant name field, enhanced merchant data enrichment, entry-mode granularity, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals at authorization time.
